files.purpose_and_callers: Todo host startup, middleware, endpoints and subscriptions.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Startup creates a fixed Todo database target at 116-120, then uses T08 startup. Redis waiter at 124-126 ignores Redis:Configuration, extending BE-017 and OPS-014. JWT precedes per-user rate limiting. Three stable T05 subscriptions share the startup lifetime token. CSRF is before routes.
files.test_evidence: DependencyInjectionContractTests, TodoGrpcServiceTests and read-only startup traces. No host/runtime executed.
files.conclusion: No separate finding for known startup mismatches. Effective listener and readiness deployment remains T14.

files.purpose_and_callers: Local launch profiles for Development, Staging and Production.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: The profiles set legacy flat TODO_DB_CONNECTION/REDIS_CONNECTION/JWT_* names. Current Todo and shared DI read ConnectionStrings:TodoDatabase, ConnectionStrings:Redis or Redis:Configuration, and JwtSettings keys. No mapping of the flat names was found in Todo/shared source. Values were redacted during this review.
files.test_evidence: Todo Infrastructure DependencyInjection.cs:24-25, shared DependencyInjection.cs:42-44 and JwtAuthenticationExtensions.cs:23-30. Direct profile startup was not executed.
files.conclusion: T14 should verify launch-profile configuration parity; a profile label does not establish the effective endpoint.

files.purpose_and_callers: Docker overrides for Todo connections, JWT, RabbitMQ, gRPC and Kestrel.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Contains separate REST and gRPC endpoint configuration and environment-overridden broker credentials. Service-key and effective ingress remain T07/T14 gates. Values were redacted.
files.test_evidence: Compared key structure with Program and infrastructure registration. No Compose/image run.
files.conclusion: Configuration intent does not establish reachable production protocols.

files.purpose_and_callers: Default Todo configuration for Redis, cache, broker, JWT, CORS and RPC services.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Default Redis:Configuration is consumed by shared DI, while Program waits on ConnectionStrings:Redis or localhost. Runtime environment overrides determine effective settings. Sensitive values were redacted.
files.test_evidence: Program:124-126 plus shared configuration. OPS-014 already tracks this split.
files.conclusion: Extend OPS-014 to Todo without duplicating the finding.

files.purpose_and_callers: Builds current and legacy materialized All friends recipient IDs.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Current deduplicates and removes Guid.Empty. Legacy filters accepted-at against CreatedAt and preserves prior explicit shares. Runtime access still requires current friendship and stored access via TodoAccessPolicy.
files.test_evidence: AllFriendsSnapshotPolicyTests.cs:10-53 and AllFriendsSnapshotBackfill* tests inspected by source.
files.conclusion: Snapshot audience is not a substitute for current authorization.

files.purpose_and_callers: Centralized direct-share maximum check and validation error.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Counts distinct nonempty IDs with Skip(MaxSharedUsers). Public-All-friends does not apply this direct-share cap. No enumeration of an unbounded trailing remainder after the threshold.
files.test_evidence: TodoValidatorTests and AllFriendsSnapshotHandlersTests exercise limit/caller semantics by source.
files.conclusion: No new independent defect found in this helper.

files.purpose_and_callers: Notification recipient filtering and compact task-title preview.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Enqueue excludes actor, empty IDs and duplicate recipients. Each call uses save-through OutboxExtensions, extending BE-002. TitlePreview slices UTF-16 at max-1 and can split a pair, extending BE-024.
files.test_evidence: TodoCommandHandlerExpandedTests.cs:1083-1143 and Common/OutboxExtensions.cs:15-25. No provider fanout fault test run here.
files.conclusion: Preserve actor exclusion while T03 stages the complete event set.

files.purpose_and_callers: Separates feed invalidation audience from content recipients.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Content requires uncached current friendship plus task visibility and narrows to owner on lookup failures. Cancellation propagates. Feed includes stored shares and only dynamic legacy public friends, a different trust purpose.
files.test_evidence: RealtimeAudienceTests and AllFriendsSnapshotPolicyTests:54-83 inspected. No live stale-group test.
files.conclusion: Keep payload-free feed signals separate from current-content authorization.

files.purpose_and_callers: Per-request calendar context and safe time-zone header resolution.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: AsyncLocal zone is restored by disposable scope. Missing/unknown/malformed/overlong IDs fall back to UTC. Middleware scope surrounds the whole request. Due dates remain calendar-day values at stored UTC midnight.
files.test_evidence: ViewerCalendarTests covers nested restore, malformed IDs, UTC fallback and urgency. No runtime suite executed in this batch.
files.conclusion: No new defect found in supported calendar flows.

files.purpose_and_callers: Caller category/open-task count projection.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: DTO contains required CategoryId/OpenCount only. Counting authorization belongs to GetCategoryTaskCounts handler, not to this type.
files.test_evidence: GetCategoryTaskCountsTests.cs inspected by source.
files.conclusion: DTO does not establish a caller boundary alone.

files.purpose_and_callers: Friend affinity score and directional share-count projection.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: The FriendId and counts come from query aggregation. This record carries no authority and performs no persistence or caching.
files.test_evidence: GetFriendAffinityTests.cs and corresponding handler symbol trace.
files.conclusion: No independent defect in the projection.

files.purpose_and_callers: Response for a caller-specific hidden-state mutation.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Contains task ID, hidden state and optional viewer-category identifiers. Task-content redaction is handled elsewhere. No writable server ownership field.
files.test_evidence: SetTodoHidden handler and controller trace. HiddenTodoDtoFactory and INV-AZ-3 remain the content boundary.
files.conclusion: Keep mutation response separate from hidden task content.

files.purpose_and_callers: Todo wire model plus AutoMapper projection for domain state.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Maps source audience and workers. Authorization/redaction occurs in handlers. Live author/worker display profiles and open-subtask count are intentionally ignored by base mapping. Priority uses enum ToString even for an undefined numeric value.
files.test_evidence: TodoItemMappingProfileTests.cs, TodoAccessPolicy.RedactAudience and frontend priority fallback inspected.
files.conclusion: Undefined persisted priority becomes a numeric string in the response.

files.purpose_and_callers: Viewer hidden/category/completion response and owner completion truth.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: The record distinguishes per-viewer completion from OwnerCompleted. No mutation or caller selection occurs in this DTO.
files.test_evidence: ViewerPreference handler/controller paths traced by symbol references.
files.conclusion: Keep author truth separate from viewer preference.

files.purpose_and_callers: Todo CQRS/validation/mapping registration and integration-handler DI.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Registers Logging, Validation and Performance in that order, plus TimeProvider and three integration consumers. No transaction pipeline wraps the save-through outbox calls.
files.test_evidence: DependencyInjectionContractTests and BE-002 existing evidence. No provider/host start.
files.conclusion: T03 must establish atomic mutation/event boundaries in handlers.

files.purpose_and_callers: Maps unavailable downstream service calls to ServiceUnavailable category.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Service/operation metadata is included without an endpoint or credentials. Client wrappers choose which RPC failures become this exception. Cancellation is not represented by this type.
files.test_evidence: Todo CategoryGrpcClient.cs:116-128 and error taxonomy tests traced.
files.conclusion: No new independent defect in the typed error.

files.purpose_and_callers: Create-subtask request with route parent and optional content/priority.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Parent route replaces the body parent ID in TodosController. Owner is inherited from the parent, actual creator from JWT. Priority is a numeric enum with no field-level validation in the DTO.
files.test_evidence: TodosController.cs:145-159 and TodoCommandHandlerExpandedTests.cs:1162-1192 inspected.
files.conclusion: The DTO must be paired with access checks and enum validation.

files.purpose_and_callers: Creates an inherited child for an authorized branch participant.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Checks current access before mutation and blocks nesting. Touches tracked parent so xmin rejects stale inherited fields. Save-through outbox exposes BE-002. Optional category enrichment uses actor userId instead of the owner whose category was inherited.
files.test_evidence: TodoCommandHandlerExpandedTests covers owner inheritance and a collaborator with no category. GetSubtasks uses parent.UserId for the same category.
files.conclusion: The collaborator create response can omit category metadata returned by the later read.

files.purpose_and_callers: Validates parent, title and description limits for subtask creation.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Requires a nonempty parent, title <=1500 and description <=2000. No rule rejects undefined numeric Priority.
files.test_evidence: TodoValidatorTests.cs:128-140 tests only the title boundary. Domain and EF priority assignments were traced.
files.conclusion: Validate enum domain before persistence.

files.purpose_and_callers: Create-todo request with explicit optional fields and owner hint.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: HTTP controller clears body UserId and the handler resolves JWT owner. Numeric priority remains part of the body contract. DueDateStart uses DueDate as its end bound.
files.test_evidence: TodosController.cs:190-204, CreateTodoCommandHandler and API.md:948-977 inspected.
files.conclusion: Do not treat the owner hint as HTTP authorization.

files.purpose_and_callers: Validates top-level task title, description, dates, worker count and share cap.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Title <=200, description <=2000, coherent due interval, workers >=1 and direct-share cap. Priority has no IsInEnum/range guard. EF stores any nonzero undefined int, such as 6 or -1.
files.test_evidence: TodoValidatorTests covers content/date limits. TodoPriority and TodoItemConfiguration:26-29 traced.
files.conclusion: Undefined values can pass validation and be projected inconsistently by the UI.

files.purpose_and_callers: Delete-task command identified by TodoId.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: No caller ID in body. Authorization and deletion/outbox fanout are in DeleteTodoCommandHandler outside this batch.
files.test_evidence: DeleteTodo handler/controller traced and BE-002/BE-005/T03 acknowledged.
files.conclusion: No independent defect in this command record.

files.purpose_and_callers: Duplicate command identified by a source task ID.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Copy ownership is the caller and source content may be copied only after current branch access. Docs specify no copied dates, completion or branch state.
files.test_evidence: DuplicateTodoCommandHandler and docs/features.md:480-496 inspected.
files.conclusion: Source ID is not a grant by itself.

files.purpose_and_callers: Copies a visible top-level task under the authenticated caller.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Blocks subtasks, checks current access, scopes category to caller and revalidates copied direct shares. All friends uses current duplicator circle. Tags are copied, dates/completion/branch are reset. Save-through creation and realtime events expose BE-002.
files.test_evidence: TodoCommandHandlerExpandedTests.cs:193-344 and CategoryGrpcClient owner check inspected.
files.conclusion: No new authorization defect found in the duplicate path; atomicity remains BE-002.

files.purpose_and_callers: Join-task command carrying only TodoId.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Membership permissions and capacity live in JoinTodoCommandHandler and domain worker methods. The request supplies no caller identity.
files.test_evidence: JoinTodo handler/domain symbols and worker tests traced.
files.conclusion: Command record alone changes no state.

new_findings.title: Создание подзадачи участником запрашивает унаследованную категорию от имени другого владельца
new_findings.trigger: Владелец A имеет категорию и делится родительской задачей с действующим другом B. B создаёт подзадачу.
new_findings.impact: Подзадача наследует CategoryId и owner A. Create handler спрашивает CategoryApi с owner B и не получает категорию. Успешный ответ не содержит CategoryName/Color/Icon, тогда как GET подзадач спрашивает owner A и заполняет эти поля. Фактическое отображение расхождения в UI не проверено.
new_findings.repro: В изолированном Npgsql и Category RPC сценарии создать владельца A, категорию A и допущенного участника B. Выполнить create-subtask как B, затем GET той же подзадачи, сравнить category fields. Сохранить отказ для чужого B category read вне авторизованного Todo пути.
new_findings.fix: T03 должен использовать owner унаследованной категории после успешной проверки доступа к родительской задаче и подтвердить одинаковое обогащение create/read. Не расширять внешний Category owner scope.

new_findings.title: Числовой приоритет вне TodoPriority проходит create validation и сохраняется как int
new_findings.trigger: Авторизованный create task или create subtask запрос передаёт числовой priority 6 или -1 вместо поддерживаемых 1–5. У create/Domain нет enum guard, как и у update validator.
new_findings.impact: Назначение Priority сохраняет неопределённое значение. EF использует integer conversion без check constraint. DTO отдаёт строку числа, frontend fallback показывает Medium, а сервер сортирует raw enum value. Для публичного numeric HTTP binding и фактического Npgsql round trip нужна отдельная проверка. Значение 0 отдельно является EF sentinel и требует отдельного контракта.
new_findings.repro: Проверить validators и HTTP create/update для -1,0,1..5,6 и int.MaxValue. В disposable Npgsql подтвердить отсутствие новых/изменённых строк для неверных значений и совместимость с историческими неизвестными значениями. Проверить сортировку и UI fallback без незаметного преобразования пользовательских данных.
new_findings.fix: T03 должен согласовать числовой enum контракт, добавить согласованный guard на входе и доменной границе, сохранить поддержку чтения исторических данных и проверить все create/update пути.

limits: Охват включает только 25 manifest paths. Supplemental callers, тесты и документы не входят в счётчик.
SHA-256 вычислены по байтам рабочего дерева, full source scope совпадает со снимком. Внешний T02 diff другого агента сохранён.
Конфигурационные значения редактированы при чтении. Активные .env, OAuth, credentials и user secrets не загружались.
Build, tests, services, Compose, database, broker, Redis, browser и нагрузочные проверки в этом batch не запускались.

BE-002 распространяется на CreateSubtask/DuplicateTodo save-through fanout. BE-017 и OPS-014 включают Program Todo. TitlePreview расширяет UTF-16 boundary BE-024. T15 должен учесть устаревшие XML owner-only комментарии контроллера при фактическом participant behavior.
Новые finding IDs локальны для READ-041. Канонические IDs назначает root. Все runtime gates остаются NOT_VERIFIED.

Todo launch profiles set legacy flat environment names that the current section-based configuration reads do not consume. This extends T14/OPS-009 configuration parity; no direct profile launch was attempted.
